excerpt.zh:
一只缇扬奇越过边境，进入了我国的[tiyanki_system.GetName]星系。由于缇扬奇已被宣布为星系害兽，任何境内有缇扬奇的星海共同体成员国都有法律义务确保这些生物被即刻消灭。

[Root.GetName]将被视为违反星系法，直至缇扬奇被处理掉或是自动离开我国境内为止。
excerpt.en: A Tiyanki pod has crossed into our space in the [tiyanki_system.GetName] system. As the Tiyanki have officially been declared galactic pests, all Galactic Community members are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any creatures present within their borders

triggers.en: When a fleet enters a system

texts.zh:
一只缇扬奇越过边境，进入了我国的[tiyanki_system.GetName]星系。由于缇扬奇已被宣布为星系害兽，任何境内有缇扬奇的星海共同体成员国都有法律义务确保这些生物被即刻消灭。

[Root.GetName]将被视为违反星系法，直至缇扬奇被处理掉或是自动离开我国境内为止。
texts.en:
A Tiyanki pod has crossed into our space in the [tiyanki_system.GetName] system. As the Tiyanki have officially been declared galactic pests, all Galactic Community members are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any creatures present within their borders.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law until the Tiyanki have either departed our space or been exterminated.

label.zh: 这些害虫必须尽快处理。
label.en: This infestation must be dealt with.
